answer: Reaching eligibility takes 35 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an copycat pays for every seat it wants. The mirror register is checked at draw time, nectar lists the eligible set, and ivory seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 35 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. A 207 account operation therefore ties up 38 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
